title: How This Year’s Super El Niño Will Worsen Global Hunger
summary: While some regions get wetter, others face massive drought. On top of wars and cuts to foreign aid, the weather phenomenon could leave millions of people in vulnerable countries without enough to eat.
llm_summary: The 2023–2024 “Super El Niño” is set to bring extreme weather—heavy rains and floods in some regions and severe droughts in others—just as wars, economic shocks and reduced foreign aid are already straining food supplies. These climate extremes will hit the world’s most vulnerable agricultural zones, threatening crop yields and driving up hunger for millions.
